About

I’m a geology graduate (GPA 3.68 out of 4.00) who is comfortable both in the field and in the planning room. I have mapped terrain on foot, modelled landslide hazard in GIS, and run events with hundreds of participants and corporate partners.

I work well in structured, detail-driven settings and in multicultural teams, and I’m looking for roles where careful fieldwork or clear coordination matters.

Fieldwork and research

Undergraduate thesis

Cisolok District, Sukabumi Regency, West Java, 2025

“Landslide Susceptibility Zonation of Cisolok District.” Combined field geological mapping with GIS-based spatial modelling to classify hazard zones.

Planned daily logistics, equipment and safety during a multi-week field program, then processed the data in ArcGIS and Global Mapper into a documented hazard zonation report.

Individual geological mapping

Field Mapping Course, Semester 6, 2024, Central Java

Mapped a 5 × 5 km² area on my own, managing route planning, sample handling and equipment under time and terrain constraints.

Ran basic lab analysis on petrographic and fossil samples and compiled everything into a geological map and technical report.
